Agent 23/35 — lift-throttle yaw balance. Establish a steady 60–110 km/h corner, abruptly lift throttle, and measure yaw-rate change, front/rear slip/load transfer and driveline drag. Determine whether the car becomes implausibly stable, spins, or pushes. Current validation lacks external reference, so separate internal consistency defects from calibration uncertainty. Do not force a preferred balance without evidence.
